director.text: Hi Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket ground ki boundary se perimeter, yaani chaaron taraf ki lambai, dekhenge. Cricket mein tumhe kya pasand hai?
Cricket pasand hai, Riya—toh ground ki boundary socho. Perimeter, yaani chaaron taraf ki kul lambai, nikalne ke liye kya-kya naapogi?
Haan Riya, bilkul. Perimeter thodi der ruk sakta hai. Tum kis baare mein baat karna chahti ho? Phir is hisse ke baad lautenge.
Riya, kisi bhi shape ka perimeter uski sabhi sides jodkar milta hai. Cricket ground ki chaar sides hon, toh kin lambaiyon ko jodogi?
Riya, “pata nahi” theek hai; maine ground ki sides saaf nahi batayi thi. Rani ke park mein length 50 m, breadth 30 m. Ek round kaise milega?
Riya, geoboard par game khelo: rectangle banao. Uski bahar wali sides ko dekho; ek round sirf unhi par chalega. Kitni sides dikh rahi hain?
Riya, perimeter ke liye shape ki poori boundary jodni hoti hai; ek side chhoot jaaye toh round adhoora rahega. Geoboard par boundary trace karke dekho.
Riya, ye boring lag raha hai. Geoboard par ab tareeka badalte hain: perimeter ko picture, story ya game se dekhein?
Riya, kaunsa tareeka chahiye: Picture dikhao, Kahani mein batao, ya Game khelte hain?
Riya, ek din Meena ne park ka poora chakkar lagaya. Woh chaaron sides par chali; isi kul raaste ko perimeter kehte hain. Meena ne kitni sides par chalna tha?
Riya, tum rukna chahti ho, theek hai. Screen par bhi teen choices hain: abhi jaari rakhein, chhota break lein, ya aaj ke liye rokein?
